definitions.explanation: Sleeves that extend to the wrist, or a garment with such sleeves. Often used as a modifier for shirts, sweaters, and other clothing.

examples.japanese: {長袖|ながそで}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦シャツ→シャツ：01052_shatsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{着|き}た→着る：00541_kiru⟧。
examples.english: I put on a long-sleeved shirt.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日焼|ひや}け→日焼け：15469_hiyake⟧⟦{防止|ぼうし}→防止：14571_boushi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{長袖|ながそで}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{選|えら}んだ→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧。
examples.english: I chose long sleeves to prevent sunburn.

examples.japanese: ⟦{秋|あき}→秋：02276_aki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{半袖|はんそで}→半袖：15518_hansode⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{長袖|ながそで}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{衣替|ころもが}え→衣替え：07709_koromogae⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: When autumn comes, I switch from short sleeves to long sleeves.

notes:
{長袖|ながそで} refers to long sleeves or any garment with long sleeves. It is everyday vocabulary used when discussing clothing choices, especially related to weather or seasons.

FORMS:
{長|なが} (long) + ⟦{袖|そで}→袖：02217_sode⟧ (sleeve). The same pattern applies to ⟦{半袖|はんそで}→半袖：15518_hansode⟧ (short sleeves, literally "half sleeves").

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {長袖|ながそで}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦シャツ→シャツ：01052_shatsu⟧: long-sleeved shirt
- {長袖|ながそで}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{着|き}る→着る：00541_kiru⟧: to wear long sleeves
- {長袖|ながそで}Tシャツ: long-sleeved T-shirt

USAGE:
Often used without a following noun — {長袖|ながそで}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{着|き}る→着る：00541_kiru⟧ means "to wear something long-sleeved." Common in conversations about weather and seasonal wardrobe changes (⟦{衣替|ころもが}え→衣替え：07709_koromogae⟧).

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{半袖|はんそで}→半袖：15518_hansode⟧: short sleeves (half sleeves)
- {七分袖|しちぶそで}: three-quarter sleeves
- ⟦{袖|そで}→袖：02217_sode⟧: sleeve
- ⟦{袖口|そでぐち}→袖口：23858_sodeguchi⟧: cuff, sleeve opening
